# dsh/.github

GitHub reads workflows, issue forms and pull request templates only from the
repository root. The workspace's CI runs from
[`.github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml`](../../.github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml).

The files kept here are not active. The publish workflow, the pull request
rules, the issue workflows and their forms stay here, next to the tests that
read them, until the release lane and the repository rules for this workspace
move to the root.

GitHub 只从仓库根目录读取工作流、Issue 表单和 PR 模板。本工作区的 CI 由
[`.github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml`](../../.github/workflows/dsh-ci.yml) 运行。

这里保留的文件目前不生效。发布工作流、PR 规范、Issue 工作流和表单暂时放在这里，
和读取它们的测试放在一起，等本工作区的发布流程和仓库规范迁到根目录时再一起移动。
